profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Uber - Delivery Marketplace Optimization

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Logistics Optimization of the UberEats and Delivery marketplace.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managing the Shared Rides (UberX Share/UberPool) team across marketplace efficiency, pricing and user experience.  Our mission is to lower the cost of transportation - and reduce carbon emissions - by building intelligent systems that match people together to share cars when they’re headed in the same direction.
- Led the team in re-launch and growth of UberX Share to 40+ cities across US, Canada and ANZ.  Met aggressive finance goals for improved profitability compared to the legacy UberPool product.
- Planned multi-year vision and technical strategy for Shared Rides with senior Product, Science and Engineering leadership. This involves balancing Rider expectations against features which may be less convenient than UberX, but allow Uber to fulfil each trip at a lower cost through marketplace efficiencies (e.g. more efficient routing & planning).
- Managed the growth of the team from 5 to 14 Engineers with specializations across data engineering, product engineering, mobile and optimization strategies.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (Tech Lead Manager)
positions.description:
Technical Leader of Shared Rides (UberX Share/UberPool) product
- Managed the scale down of the UberPool product due to COVID while maintaining support for Sharing (multi-rider/batched trips) leading a small team of 5 engineers.  
- Set the technical roadmap for relaunch of Shared Rides.  This included planning and execution of complex migrations of batched trips as part of company-wide refactor of Uber's core logistics state maching, pricing/fare generation platforms and significant updates to the Rider and Earner facing UX.
- Worked with Product and Business stakeholders to re-define the Shared Rides value proposition to a hybrid of upfront discount with additional matched savings.
- Key design and implemention of a Rider Offer platform.  Detect opportunities to offer a value proposition such as improved reliability or a discount to a Rider while also generating marketplace efficiencies (i.e. a better overall trip) for the Earner and Uber.

positions.title: Software Engineer/R&D Consultant
positions.description:
Exploring technologies to showcase and generate high quality CG assets for use in augmented reality and retail store based applications.

Worked extensively on an automotive in-store kiosks based on Unreal Engine 4.  This included implementation of a HTML5 based front-end as well as work on the UE4 engine and Flask based backend. Work also included implementation of Analytics and integration with EDM technology.

Investigated Kinect, photogammetry and similar technologies for assisted creation of 3D Assets.   This focussed on low cost, real time creation of 3D assets, object tracking and localisation problems.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Consulting and implementation of Web Analytics tracking for enterprise scale websites in the airline banking and insurance sectors.

Design, implementation and analysis of results from A/B and multivariate testing using Adobe Target, Optimizely and other technologies.

Implementation of analytics solutions using Tag Management providers including Ensighten, Tealium, Adobe Dynamic Tag Manager and Google Tag Manager.

Analysis of data using statistical modeling and interactive visualisation.

Develop in-house software solutions to streamline analysis and present data to clients.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
SharePoint Consulting focusing on implementation of Document Management solutions for enterprise clients including law firms, professional services firms and financial institutions.

Development of SharePoint and Microsoft Office integrations programming in C#, utilizing .NET and various Microsoft technologies.

Setup and maintenance of SharePoint development and testing environments.

positions.title: Solicitor
positions.description:
Advice and general litigation focusing on Retail Banking and the financial sector.
Experience with large scale litigations, including strategy and management of electronic discovery solutions for millions documents and records.

honors.title: Postgraduate Performance Prize
honors.description: Awarded for placing in the top 10 students in Postgraduate coursework in the school of Computer Science and Engineering for Semester 2 2013 .

publications.title: Legg and Turner, "When Discovery and Technology Meet: The Pre-Discovery Conference" (2011) 21 Journal of Judicial Administration 54
Legg, Park, Turner and Travers, "The Rise and Regulation of Litigation Funding in Australia" (2011) 38 (4) Northern Kentucky Law Review 625
